ProsperityWolvesIntro.8.easy: They believed that every creature was special in its own way, and they were sure that change for the better could control the wishes of any creature, human or beast. With that hope in their empty hearts, they tried to spread a message of love and acceptance to all humans.
ProsperityWolvesIntro.8.short: Believing every creature special and any impulse tameable, they spread a message of love and acceptance to all humans.

ProsperityWolvesIntro.10.full: Had the human inhabitants not suddenly found themselves outnumbered by a den of nightmarish beings, they may have voiced their opposition with violent reprisal. But, with no option to the contrary, the monsters retained their hellish visages and life returned to a semblance of normalcy.
ProsperityWolvesIntro.10.easy: If the humans had not suddenly found that there were more nightmare creatures than humans, they might have fought back violently. But they had no other choice, so the monsters kept their hellish faces, and life became almost normal again.
ProsperityWolvesIntro.10.short: Outnumbered by nightmares, the humans could not resist. The monsters kept their hellish faces, and life became almost normal.

ProsperityWolvesIntro.11.full: That is, until the scientists once again began their work in earnest and attracted the Order's attention.
ProsperityWolvesIntro.11.easy: That is, until the scientists started their work again and the Order noticed them.
ProsperityWolvesIntro.11.short: Until the scientists resumed their work and drew the Order's attention.

END-HuntersEvil2.2.full: While this history may contain a modicum of inconceivable occurrences that stretch the limits of the imagination, it remains a peculiar story relegated to an obscure place and time. It is a mostly forgotten artifact of an era of pseudo-science and speculation that amounted to very little historical significance.
END-HuntersEvil2.2.easy: This history may contain a few unbelievable events that go beyond the limits of imagination, but it is still a strange story from an unknown place and time. It is a mostly forgotten object from a time of false science and guesswork that had very little importance for history.
END-HuntersEvil2.2.short: However incredible, this remains an obscure story, a forgotten relic of an age of pseudo-science of little historical significance.

END-HuntersEvil2.3.full: For it was not the experimentations of {0} ambitious and incredulous scientists that were remembered, it was the Hunters that amassed fame, wealth, and respect on the backs of the superstitious peasants. The disease that wreaked havoc on the countryside was ignored; recast as a demonic presence from folklore; one that could only be kept at bay through the continued vigilance of the Fraternity of Hunters, which of course came at a great financial cost.
END-HuntersEvil2.3.easy: Because people did not remember the experiments of {0} ambitious and doubtful scientists. They remembered the Hunters, who became famous, rich and respected on the backs of the superstitious peasants. The disease that destroyed the countryside was ignored, and it was turned into a demon from folk tales that could only be kept away by the constant watch of the Fraternity of Hunters, which of course cost a lot of money.
END-HuntersEvil2.3.short: Not {0} ambitious scientists, but the Hunters were remembered, enriched by superstitious peasants. The disease was recast as a demon only the Fraternity could keep at bay, for a great price.

END-HuntersEvil2.4.full: Over the next several years, the Fraternity and its members abandoned the town for more lucrative positions within the government. Soon the not-so-secret society became the affluent aristocrats controlling the entirety of the Hungarian political establishment from the shadows. And the family, who once commanded a measure of reverence, were assigned to obscure prefectures of their own across the country.
END-HuntersEvil2.4.easy: In the next years, the Fraternity and its members left the town for better-paid jobs in the government. Soon the not-so-secret society became the rich aristocrats who secretly controlled all of Hungarian politics. And the family, who were once respected, were given unimportant posts of their own in different parts of the country.
END-HuntersEvil2.4.short: The Fraternity left for lucrative government posts and soon ruled Hungarian politics from the shadows. The once-revered family was dispatched to obscure prefectures.

END-HuntersEvil2.5.full: If this story is to be believed, then their knowledge still remains trapped within the decaying walls of stone estates overlooking the forgotten village of {0}. The work was finally over.
END-HuntersEvil2.5.easy: If this story is true, then their knowledge is still locked inside the crumbling walls of stone houses above the forgotten village of {0}. The work was finally over.
END-HuntersEvil2.5.short: If this story is true, their knowledge remains trapped in the decaying estates above forgotten {0}. The work was finally over.

END-WolvesEvil2.2.full: I write these final words under candle-light, from a shelter I have fashioned in the crawl-space beneath the manor. For a desk, a dusty plank of cedar. I try to keep my utensils above the floor which can become musty and dank during my frequent overnight stays: a dull quill, ink, several lengths of charcoal, a ream of parchment. It is no longer safe to sleep in my bed when night falls. The creatures emerge from the shadows to feed on the few souls that still remain, or to irreversibly change them into shambling horrors most unimaginable.
END-WolvesEvil2.2.easy: I write these last words by candlelight, from a hiding place I have made in the low space under the house. My desk is a dusty board of cedar wood. I try to keep my things off the floor, which can get damp and smelly during my many nights here: an old feather pen, ink, a few pieces of charcoal, a pile of paper. It is no longer safe to sleep in my bed when night comes. The creatures come out of the shadows to feed on the few people who are still left, or to change them forever into terrible walking horrors.
END-WolvesEvil2.2.short: I write by candlelight from the crawl-space beneath the manor, a cedar plank for a desk. It is no longer safe to sleep in my bed. The creatures emerge at night to feed on the few who remain, or to change them into shambling horrors.

END-WolvesEvil2.3.full: To think that my work to uncover the genealogy of a mildly successful scientific family would cause me to become consumed by a maelstrom of spreading evil! It is my hope that when I complete this writing (if I complete this writing), that these words will offer a history to condemn these fools and their complicity with demons. The world must know who is responsible. It must condemn the group who coddled darkness and made a mockery of science!
END-WolvesEvil2.3.easy: To think that my work on the family history of a fairly successful family of scientists would pull me into a storm of spreading evil! I hope that when I finish this writing (if I finish it), these words will be a history that condemns these fools and their help for demons. The world must know who is responsible. It must condemn the group that protected the darkness and made a joke of science!
END-WolvesEvil2.3.short: A genealogy of minor scientists has drawn me into a maelstrom of evil! If I finish this, may it condemn these fools who coddled darkness and mocked science!

END-WolvesEvil2.4.full: O God, I hear the creatures again! Their malformed claw-tips scratching at the floorboards! Damn them for what they have done! Damn this infernal work. For it has unleashed a plague upon the land of which there can be no end in sight.
END-WolvesEvil2.4.easy: Oh God, I hear the creatures again! Their twisted claws are scratching at the floorboards! Damn them for what they have done! Damn this terrible work. It has brought a plague over the land, and there is no end in sight.
END-WolvesEvil2.4.short: O God, their claws scratch at the floorboards again! Damn them, and this infernal work. The plague has no end in sight.

log.S5Special1.title.full: The Town Is in Need of Direction

log.S5Special1.summary.full: After the untimely death of the current mayor (and the previous three) the town was once again embroiled in politics.

log.S5SpecialSetup1.summary.full: The mayor chooses between building a bank or a library.

log.S5Fate1.summary.full: The village of Xvillage was for lack of a more appropriate term agricultural in its funds and like many similar small villages were woefully unprepared for the ravages of disease.

log.S5Specialbar1.summary.full: Cousins became frustrated by lack of modern convenience.

log.SymposiumFail.summary.full: The cousins were informed that they would not be receiving any invitations for lecture opportunities in the future.

log.SymposiumSuccess.summary.full: Despite a lack of traditional form the professors all agreed that it was the inexorably excitable demeanor of the cousins that so enamored them.

log.Changes.summary.full: A morning ride allowed the aging aristocrats a chance to ruminate on the melancholic dour beauty of the region.

log.CureMoonSick1.summary.full: Lucid memories of stalking prey in the woods haunted the cousins dreams yet filled them with a terrible energy.

log.Panacea.summary.full: After years of tireless dedication a solution to the ails of all men had been formulated.

log.Panacea1.summary.full: In a shocking display of altruism the findings were published in a series of medical journals at the behest of the university's administration.

log.SymposiumEvent3.title.full: The Fate of the Lecture Series

log.SymposiumEvent3.summary.full: The lecture series comes to a close.

log.S5Special1b.summary.full: The family had made their first mark on the history of the town for good or ill.

log.FeverServe1.summary.full: Two young aristocrats and their spouses moved to a small village in France.

log.FeverServe2.summary.full: A former business associate of their mother's requested a daughter be put under each of the houses' charge.

log.Dubious.summary.full: The bishop entreated the cousins to donate time and money to help aid the sick at the church.

log.ElecY.summary.full: The mob's flaming torches set the Hospital and Town Hall ablaze leaving multiple individuals severely injured or deceased as they continued into the nearby hills.

log.ElecN.summary.full: The townspeople sifted through the cousins; erudite proposal at the next town meeting and realized that they intended to support their ridiculous distrust of modern convenience.

log.Lettercode.summary.full: The cousins were amused to receive a plain letter of correspondence sealed with wax.

log.NoUni3b.summary.full: Any player with a token that is not currently overtaken by the Angry Mob receives one final Perform Experiment action.

log.BuildingsEnd.summary.full: The town began to attract new interest from those with both genuine and nefarious motivations

log.S5Special1a.summary.full: All players take all their money into their hands and they then secretly choose any amount to place into their right hand to bid on becoming Mayor

log.DiseaseConsequence.summary.full: The group of young scientists found themselves stricken with a chronic illness that would remain with them for their entire lives.

log.Immortality.summary.full: A deep restlessness had set into the minds of each and even on the cusp of approval from the academic community they could not quell these thoughts.

log.DetEffect1.summary.full: Sick and unable to heal again stumbling blindly until the bones were brittle enough to snap their bodies had finally failed them.

log.DetEffect2.summary.full: They feared that their hasty solution had borne upon them irreversible effects.

log.DetEffect3.summary.full: They feared that their hasty solution had borne upon them irreversible effects.

log.InfinityClick1.summary.full: It seemed unimaginable; not simply a cure for all disease but a mysterious contrivance to extend life indefinitely.

log.WolvesVote.summary.full: Players will vote on whether to unleash this concoction to tame the demonic beasts of the land. Players will secretly choose a side to place face up in their palm. Then they will close their fist and extend it to the center of the table. Tally all the votes and the side with the most votes wins.
